lesson_yaml:
schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: java-openam-unsafe-objectinputstream-deserialize
title: Unrestricted Java deserialization of byte[] input via ObjectInputStream.readObject
summary: 'A method takes a byte[] parameter (for example the decoded jato.clientSession request parameter),
  wraps it in an ObjectInputStream or subclass such as ApplicationObjectInputStream, and calls readObject()
  with no class allow-list. An unauthenticated attacker can send a gadget-chain payload and achieve remote
  code execution. The fix routes deserialization through a hardened helper (IOUtils.deserialise) that
  restricts which classes may be deserialized.

  '

- CWE-502
severity: critical
confidence: medium

  patched_ref: 014007c63cacc834cc795a89fac0e611aebc4a32
  repository: https://github.com/OpenIdentityPlatform/OpenAM
rule:
  message: 'A byte[] parameter flows into an ObjectInputStream (or subclass) that is read with readObject()
    and has no class allow-list. Untrusted data can lead to RCE through gadget chains. Use a filtering
    deserialiser such as IOUtils.deserialise instead.

    '
  mode: taint
  pattern-sources:
  - patterns:
    - pattern-inside: "$RET $METHOD(..., byte[] $B, ...) {\n  ...\n}\n"
    - pattern: $B
  pattern-sinks:
  - patterns:
    - pattern: new ApplicationObjectInputStream($IN)
    - focus-metavariable: $IN
  - patterns:
    - pattern: new ObjectInputStream($IN)
    - focus-metavariable: $IN
  - patterns:
    - pattern: $OIS.readObject()
    - focus-metavariable: $OIS
fix:
  guidance: 'Do not deserialize attacker-controllable bytes with a plain ObjectInputStream. Use the project''s
    hardened helper (IOUtils.deserialise) that enforces a class allow-list or ObjectInputFilter, and prefer
    a non-Java-serialization format such as JSON for client-side state. Authenticate or sign the client
    session data before processing it.

    '
  example: "public static Object deserialize(byte[] b, boolean compressed)\n        throws IOException,\
    \ ClassNotFoundException {\n    return IOUtils.deserialise(b, compressed);\n}\n"
